source.description:
## PROBLEM

Main branch protection currently requires only: OSV scan, Semgrep scan, Gitleaks scan.

The 'test (22.x, 3.11)' CI check is NOT required, so PRs with failing unit tests can still be merged via auto-merge if the three self-hosted scans pass. Concrete recurrence: PR #446 (xtrm-f42ns.8, UX consolidation) merged 2026-07-20 with 2 failing tests in update.test.ts — required a follow-up PR #447 (xtrm-f42ns.10) to restore CI green on main.

## SUCCESS

- 'test (22.x, 3.11)' added to main's required-checks list
- No orchestrator can auto-merge a PR with a failing unit test
- Docs updated if the repo has a CONTRIBUTING or similar

## SCOPE

- GitHub branch protection settings on main (via `gh api repos/xtrm-dev/core/branches/main/protection` or web UI)
- No repo code changes required

## NON_GOALS

- Do NOT add every ancillary workflow (Socket Security etc) as required — pick the one that gates actual test correctness
- Do NOT touch CI matrix expansion — separate infra concern

## VALIDATION

- [ ] `gh api repos/xtrm-dev/core/branches/main/protection` shows 'test (22.x, 3.11)' in required_status_checks.contexts
- [ ] Test the guard: open a PR with a deliberate test failure, verify auto-merge stays BLOCKED
source.title: require 'test (22.x, 3.11)' CI check on main branch protection
